Digitiser's credit band at bottom is excluded.

main_text.p: denter mentienti. Auditus nuper balatrones in specubus & puteis delitescere dejerabat, qui loquentibus obstreperent, & extrema dictionum importuni regererent: Credant hoc Philosophi illi, quos Manducus vesperi ad cunas abigit invitos. Et denique Tactus (mirum, quantum hic sibi sumpserit præ fratribus suis) nunquid urinatoribus sæpius jam suasit, & persuasit forte, nullum maris, etiam classibus constrati pondus esse? Hæc & id genus alia mendacia innumera, aperta, splendida satis arguunt, quemlibet de quinque illis fratribus, si suas tantum tendiculas objecerit, frustra fore, nec decepturum eorum quemquam, qui mediocriter sapiunt. Quod si tamen conspirare possent Sensus, & facta manu nos adoriri, nullus dubito, quin facilè circumvenire quem-

page.notes: Faint show-through and the cut-off text at the left edge are not transcribed. Doubtful: "Tactus" may be printed with a ligature; "facta" appears as "factâ" in print. The word "quem-" at the foot is the line-ending catchword. Original spelling retained, including "si" and "Quod·si".
